SPA Cenvaree at Centara Grand Krabi

Beachfront spa on the secluded Pai Plong Bay

Krabi/Spa/SPA Cenvaree at Centara Grand Krabi

About

SPA Cenvaree at Centara Grand Beach Resort & Villas Krabi overlooks the secluded Pai Plong bay, accessible only by boat or jungle footpath. Treatments blend Thai traditions with contemporary techniques in an unforgettable coastal setting.

SPA Cenvaree 位于甲米圣塔拉大酒店，俯瞰僻静的攀龙湾——只能乘船或穿越丛林小径抵达。在无与伦比的海岸环境中，泰式传统与现代技法完美融合。
